recipe.visualDefinition: A gritty, low-angle portrait of two men in casual rustic attire sitting in leather chairs against a weathered wooden wall, framed by heavy distressed slab-serif typography at the top and a gestural signature-style mark at the bottom.
coreVisualRelationships: Symmetry between the two seated figures creates a balanced but informal composition.
The low-angle perspective emphasizes the subjects' presence and the texture of the wooden floor.
High-contrast lighting creates deep shadows, enhancing the 'outlaw' or rugged aesthetic.
Textural harmony between the weathered wood background and the distressed treatment of the typography.
coreInvariants: Desaturated color palette with earthy tones.
Heavy vignette effect drawing focus to the center.
Distressed, stone-like texture applied to the primary display text.

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Two subjects centered horizontally, occupying the middle third of the frame vertically, scaled to appear imposing.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The primary title at the top center acts as the heaviest visual weight.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the top title, moves down through the subjects' faces, and settles on the gestural mark at the bottom.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Utilized in the upper and lower margins to house typography without obscuring the subjects.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Muted browns and greys from the wooden interior.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Deep blacks in the shadows and leather chairs.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Faded orange and blue from the camouflage and denim clothing.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation across all channels with high value contrast in the highlights and shadows.

letterConstructionRules: Internal distressing mimicking cracked stone or weathered wood
characterSpecificRedesigns: Spurs added to the vertical stems of letters like 'H' and 'M'
Eroded counters to enhance the aged look
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: High-contrast pairing of a heavy, rigid slab-serif with a light, fluid gestural script.

candidateDirections.reason: Captures the spurred, western slab-serif aesthetic.
The bottom text requires a unique, non-font appearance to look authentic.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a low-angle photograph of two men in rustic clothing (camo jacket, denim, cowboy hat, baseball cap) sitting in dark leather armchairs inside a weathered wooden barn. Use desaturated, high-contrast lighting with a heavy vignette.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Apply a heavy, distressed slab-serif title in all caps at the top center with a cracked stone texture. Add a light, gestural off-white signature-style mark at the bottom center, slightly transparent to blend with the floor texture.

verificationChecks: Is the lighting high-contrast and moody?
Does the top text have a visible weathered texture?
Is the color palette desaturated and earthy?

adjustableVariables: Level of distressing on the typography
Specific clothing items (e.g., swapping camo for flannel)
mustRedesign: Any specific brand logos on hats or shoes
The specific facial features of the subjects
The exact wording of the text
postGenerationChecks: The image feels like a cohesive music album cover.
The typography does not look like a clean digital font overlay.
The subjects look integrated into the environment.
The mood is consistently rugged and 'outlaw'.
recipe.reuseFormula: Rustic Portrait + Low Angle + Distressed Slab Serif + Desaturated Earth Tones
